roles.summary: Trusted by management to own the complex's internal systems and IT — I build software, automate clinical and administrative workflows, and integrate AI and messaging tools that save the team hours every day.
highlights: Appointed by management as the responsible owner of IT and social-media account security across the complex.

Led research, vendor meetings, and price-quote comparison for a Hospital Information System (HIS), a patient Queue Management System, and the complex's website — driving systems-analysis and procurement decisions.
Verified the complex's official WhatsApp Business number and built a WhatsApp patient-communication platform on Chatwoot to centralize conversations and improve response quality.
Automated lab result delivery with n8n, so results reach patients automatically instead of being sent by hand.
Deployed an AI auto-reply assistant (Typebot) that answers common patient inquiries instantly.
Built a networked transfer system for the ultrasound (sonar) department, replacing manual flash-drive handoffs, plus a tool for the team to send results directly to patients.
Developed a custom accounting application for the dental laboratory.
Provide hands-on hardware and device troubleshooting and support across branches.

roles.summary: Built product and marketing experiences for an Arabic-first real-time communication platform and its clients.
highlights: Implemented Single Sign-On (SSO) authentication, login/registration, and multi-gateway payments (Stripe, Fawry, Paymob) with automated invoicing for the Vconnct/VCloud platform.
Developed the Vconnct dashboard and multiple high-conversion marketing landing pages with Next.js, TypeScript, and Tailwind CSS.
Built client dashboards and websites — including the qrrib dashboard and website — and integrated Strapi for dynamic content management.
